title: Open dynamics with a moving hole: inhomogeneous IFS and exponential separation condition
summary: Let $\mathcal F=\{f_i(x)=r_i x+t_i\}_{i=0}^{b-1}$ be a self-similar iterated function system (IFS) on $\mathbb R$ with $b\ge 3$, and let $K_{\mathcal F}$ be the associated self-similar set. Given $m\in\mathbb N$, for any sequence $ω=ω^0ω^1\ldots$ with each $ω^i\in \{0,1,\ldots,b-1\}^m$ a block of length $m$, let \[ K_{\mathcal F}^ω:=π_{\mathcal F}\left(\{(d_i)\in \{0,1,\ldots,b-1\}^{\mathbb N}: d_{k+1}d_{k+2}\ldots d_{k+m}\neω^k\quad\forall k\ge 0\}\right), \] where $π_{\mathcal F}$ is the natural coding map from $\{0,1,\ldots,b-1\}^{\mathbb N}$ to $K_{\mathcal F}$.
